case_title: P. Rathinam v. Union of India
ratio_decidendi: Right to life under Article 21 includes right to live with human dignity and personal liberty.

case_title: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
ratio_decidendi: Arrest should not be automatic upon filing of complaint for offenses punishable with imprisonment up to 7 years without satisfying notice requirements.

case_title: Lucknow Development Authority v. M.K. Gupta
ratio_decidendi: Housing construction and statutory body services fall within the definition of service under consumer protection law.
